PantryItem.title: PantryItem
PantryItem.description: A food or household item currently in the user's kitchen inventory.

id.description: Unique identifier of the pantry item.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., pcs, g, l, units, cans, items).

expiryDate.description: The date when this item expires (ISO timestamp).

lowStockThreshold.description: Threshold below which low-stock alerts trigger.

userId.description: UID of the owner of this item.

category.description: The general food category (e.g., Dairy, Produce, Bakery, Pantry).

ShoppingItem.title: ShoppingItem
ShoppingItem.description: An item on the user's active grocery shopping list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping item.

checked.description: Whether the user has picked up this item.

autoGenerated.description: Whether this shopping item was auto-created due to low stock in pantry.

ConsumptionLog.title: ConsumptionLog
ConsumptionLog.description: A historic record log of grocery item usage for tracking consumption habits.

id.description: Unique identifier for the log entry.

action.description: Type of action (e.g., consumed, expired, wasted, purchased).

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Notification and threshold settings for an individual user.

pushNotificationsEnabled.description: Whether system-wide push notifications are globally active.

lowStockAlertsEnabled.description: Whether to warn of low stocks via screen alerts/logs.

expiryReminderDays.description: Days before expiry to issue alerts.

customCategories.description: Custom pantry categories defined by the user.

/pantry/{itemId}.description: Secure collection storing food items mapped by user.

/consumptionLogs/{logId}.description: Historically tracked food usage metadata for bento reports.
